A data row with fewer cells than the header is padded to the declared column count

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<table><tr><th>A</th><th>B</th><th>C</th></tr><tr><td>1</td><td>2</td></tr></table>", ConversionOptions.builder().build());
        System.out.println(result.content());
    }
}
```
